raw_benchmarks_and_baselines: Global raw reports/downloads/runtime packages remain; all artifacts inside retiredworktrees retained in lossless verifiedarchives.

remaining_infrastructure: WSL root filesystem remains emergency read-only; no remount/restart/repair performed.
